reason: GroupsController#members now unconditionally defaults to limit=50 for all groups (app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-26) and Discourse.Group#findMembers sends limit: 50, offset: 0 (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:10-29). The public group members route only calls model.findMembers() once (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6:8-12) and its template renders members with no pagination or load-more controls (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs:1-21), so members beyond the 50th cannot be reached.
